description: Source code for an Odoo report parser class 'Overdue' that generates overdue account reports, including methods for retrieving partner addresses, phone numbers, move lines, and message content.

classes.name: Overdue
classes.description: A report parser class for overdue account reports, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Overdue parser, setting up local context with helper functions and modules.

methods.name: _adr_get
methods.description: Retrieves address details for a partner based on address type.

methods.name: _tel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the phone number for a partner's invoice address.

methods.name: _lines_get
methods.description: Fetches account move lines for a partner that are receivable or payable and not reconciled.

methods.name: _message
methods.description: Retrieves the overdue message for a company in the context of a partner object.
